head: One UI 9.5 Quick Panel: new search when you edit the buttons
dek: The One UI 9.5 beta lets you search for a Quick Panel button by app or feature name while you edit the panel, instead of scrolling through the whole list. Samsung didn't list it in the beta's notes; it showed up in a video posted on X by Tarun Vats.
details: The One UI 9.5 beta started rolling out the week before 23 November, with the Galaxy S26 series first and more phones expected later. The same beta brings Pro and Pro video mode changes, Mindful Note and Medications in Samsung Health, a floating accessibility shortcut and App Lock. Samsung says 21 Good Lock modules already work with it. The stable update isn't coming in 2026; it's expected with the Galaxy S27 series in January or February 2027.
where: Galaxy S26 series in the One UI 9.5 beta; stable version expected in early 2027
means: If you keep a lot of Quick Panel buttons, finding the one you want to add or move gets quicker after the update.
todo: On the beta, open the Quick Panel's edit view and type the button's name into the search. On other Galaxy phones, nothing to do yet.
